entries.title: SimTower
entries.definitive_edition: Original SimTower: The Vertical Empire via owned Windows/Mac media

emulation.notes: Use owned media and document environment because compatibility behavior is part of preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Windows/Mac release on period-compatible hardware or VM

primary.platform: Windows 3.x / classic Mac using owned original media
primary.version: Original SimTower: The Vertical Empire release
primary.why: SimTower has no sourced current storefront route, so preservation depends on owned Windows/Mac media and period-compatible execution. The original PC/Mac route preserves the Maxis-published tower simulation before later Yoot Tower/Yoot Saito follow-ups.
primary.how_to_play: Use owned original media in a period Windows/Mac environment or accurate VM/emulation. Record OS/emulator, version/region, display mode, tower rating, tenant mix, disasters/events, save files, and whether Yoot Tower was only referenced rather than played.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if preserving Mac release behavior.
secondary.why: Windows and Mac are both original-era routes; document which one was used.

secondary.what_to_play: Track as a separate entry if it appears in the queue.
